title: Repair Malformed JSONs to Overlay (patched tool)
abstract: Repairs the three malformed raw logs into shared overlay using tolerant parsing, trailing comma removal, and control-char escaping.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
from progressor_tools.repair_json import repair_file

bad = [
  'storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/gen_10_eval_489.json',
  'storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/gen_8_eval_480.json',
  'storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs/gen_9_eval_485.json'
]
results = [repair_file(p) for p in bad]
print("REPAIR_RESULTS:", results)
